- Source equality in some files does not imply adoption authority over every file in a package.

### Planned verification

- Compare source/root task_state.py and related skills to identify local-only intake and 30-day closure rules.
- Reinspect root guidance, registry, unrelated edits, licenses and exact protected paths before adoption.
